steps.en: Start a project: hosted, or the official Docker Compose bundle on your own server
steps.zh: 开一个项目：用托管版，或在自己服务器上跑官方 Docker Compose 包
steps.code: curl -fsSL https://supabase.link/setup.sh | sh · sh run.sh start

steps.en: Runs Postgres plus Auth, REST, Realtime, Storage and Functions behind one API gateway
steps.zh: 跑起 Postgres 和认证、REST、实时、存储等服务，挂在同一网关后

steps.en: Define tables and row-level security policies in plain SQL
steps.zh: 用普通 SQL 建表、写行级安全策略
steps.code: alter table ... enable row level security

steps.en: Exposes every table as a REST endpoint automatically, no API code written
steps.zh: 自动把每张表暴露成 REST 接口，不用写 API 代码

steps.en: Call it from the browser or app with the client library and a publishable key
steps.zh: 在浏览器或 App 里用客户端库和公开 key 直接调用

steps.en: Signs users in, then lets Postgres apply your policies to every request
steps.zh: 负责用户登录，再由 Postgres 对每个请求执行你的策略

value.en: Auth, APIs, realtime and storage on a real Postgres — the server-side code you write is mostly SQL
value.zh: 在真正的 Postgres 上拿到认证、API、实时和存储，你写的服务端代码基本只剩 SQL

sources: https://github.com/supabase/supabase apps/docs/content/guides/self-hosting/docker.mdx (Quick start: curl -fsSL https://supabase.link/setup.sh | sh; cd supabase-project && sh run.sh start; all APIs behind one gateway on :8000, /rest/v1/ /auth/v1/ /storage/v1/ /realtime/v1/)
https://github.com/supabase/supabase docker/README.md and docker/docker-compose.yml (Envoy gateway, Auth, PostgREST, Realtime, Storage, Edge Runtime, Supavisor, Postgres services)
https://github.com/supabase/supabase apps/docs/content/guides/database/postgres/row-level-security.mdx (alter table public.announcements enable row level security; create policy ...)
https://github.com/supabase/supabase README How it works (PostgREST turns Postgres into a RESTful API; GoTrue JWT auth)
